finding.claim: Linux XHamster failures are DPI/edge-specific, not catalog or DNS-resolution absence.
observations: With Direct Method OFF, ISP/system DNS may hijack xhamster.com to 10.10.34.35.
With Direct Method ACTIVE, encrypted DNS resolves real Cloudflare edges 104.16.3.81/104.16.4.81.
Balanced/targeted and strong/targeted can fail XHamster while XVideos/XNXX/Reddit remain usable.
Compatibility sometimes passed XHamster but was edge-unstable, so profile-wide switching is insufficient.

methodEvidence.testMode: clean HTTPS-only nfqws blockcheck; Direct Method OFF; no other DPI process; IPv4; real xhamster Cloudflare IPs forced in test resolver

decision.claim: Apply the proven multisplit/sniext+1 override only to the Linux XHamster family hostlist; keep Reddit on the normal/core target path and leave Windows unchanged.
decision.rationale: Minimum sufficient change. It avoids global strategy escalation that regresses other sites, preserves existing XVideos/XNXX/Reddit behavior, and follows zapret upstream blockcheck evidence on the affected Linux network.
